title: WORKSKIP leg (f2): solo host WORKS the register of his own UNSTAFFED clothing store, NO skip: clock to 15:50, 1x past 16:00 -> the GAME ends the shift by itself at closing (H-SHIFTEND-1).
preconditions: MEASUREMENT ONLY (bug 20260926-213955, H-WORKFF-1 part 2). Reporter fixture fx-hq1 (vars.keepMerger true, as every fx-hq1 scenario), SOLO: the client is dropped before the host hosts. Shop = the host's clothing store vars.shop (Crown Clothing). THE PLAYER IS THE ONLY CASHIER: all 14 fixture shifts cleared with `shiftclear` before entering and asserted by schedcount; then the DEV lever `work on` seats the host at the nearest register by the game's own click path, asserted with `work state` (working=True = the current PlayerActivity is a WorkActivity in state Running and the player is the station's employee). Same start as part 1: setup skip outdoors to 08:45, enter, `clock 09:59`, window opens hour 10 (asserted). NOTHING IS SAVED. F2 (H-SHIFTEND-1, 2026-09-26): same start as e2 up to the window-start reads; then NO skip - `clock 15:50` and the game runs at 1x past the shop's closing (16:00). The mod leaves the WorkActivity's finish to the game, so WorkActivity.Perform finishes the shift itself: '[Rest] seated -> False' and working=False by ~16:02; the new log line '[Rest] work activity - finish left to the game (shift end 16:00)' is asserted once per sit. `work state` now also prints finish=<hh:mm> (the game's _finishTime).
